Ticket 4d9115eb04cd (a seal that cannot be reproven rides the ruled ladder) — its why is the LADDER (rungs), and it names the identity 'seal-red-<component>' in passing; this ticket changes the key's derivation, not the ladder — a distinction, and the open question asks which grain. value.falsifier_check: DONE when (1) the tester's raise and clear of a seal trouble share ONE identity derived by one function at one address that both cairn/devices/tester/reseal.py and cairn/devices/tester/validation_store.py call; (2) a proof under a temp log root asserts that a seal turned red by the ladder and green by a HAND seal (TesterDevice.run_proof) leaves nothing outstanding for cc, and that a green reseal with nothing raised emits no clear; (3) the raise/clear census over ~/.cairn/logs/tester/0 restricted to emissions after the build commit shows every raised identity cleared under the same key once its seal is green and no clear without a prior raise. RED if any clear is emitted for a key nothing raised, or if the two files still spell the identity separately. WRONG INTENT if the two keys were meant as two troubles (component-level roll-up vs per-proof) — then the fix is a recorded pairing between them, not a merge; the open question decides which.
value.missing_check: One point is deliberately NOT wrapped and is the open question: whether the one identity is per PROOF (the store's grain; finer; what a hand seal knows) or per COMPONENT (the ladder's grain; what ticket 4d9115eb04cd's rung-3 language names). Everything else is wrapped: the two emitters, their four sites (reseal.py:363/412/437/484, validation_store.py:560/789-811), the proof shape, the census.

value.better_approach: Looked: dropping one emitter outright (the ladder raises, the store never announces) is smaller, but the store's announce is the only emitter a HAND seal ever reaches, and hand seals are how every voyage seals. Keeping both emitters and unifying the KEY is the smallest change that makes the fold correct.
value.hidden_assumption: That the trouble fold matches clears to raises by identity string alone. If the drain host (absent — trouble-drain-has-no-host-the-beat-backstop-is-prose) ever folds by proof path instead, the mismatch is invisible; measured today it is not folding at all, so the log tree IS the record.
value.prior_art: In-house: reseal.py's CLEARS_FOR comment (2026-09-13) fixed the RECIPIENT of the clear after 11 of 12 seal-red troubles stayed open — same fold, a neighbouring axis; ticket 9579a6f9cec6 (2026-09-08) moved the store's clear from a bus request to an emission. Neither touched the identity. Ticket a48f95c51a41 (a validation is one current record) is the store side. No ticket in the corpus names the raise/clear identity mismatch (grep seal-red + validation-verdict-changed over tickets/: four hits, none about identity).
value.real_collision: None exclusive-and-terminal. Component-level identity (the ladder's) and proof-level identity (the store's) are both defensible; the ruling on rung-3 reds (4d9115eb04cd) speaks of a component's seal-red — so the per-proof key must still let a component-level reader roll up. A distinction to record, not a collision.

decision.amended: 2026-09-16 by CC after rehearsal pass 1: both bodies recorded so the build is determinate under either answer to open-69cd989012c4
decision.text: THE ONE FUNCTION: def seal_trouble_identity(proof_path) -> str in cairn/devices/tester/validation_store.py (the store side — reseal.py already imports from it; base may not import a device; trouble may not be imported by tester). Body under the per-PROOF grain (open-69cd989012c4 standing; if the answer is per COMPONENT only this body changes): returns "seal-red-" + the proof's repo-relative path with .py stripped, slugged by reseal._SLUG (e.g. seal-red-cairn-devices-tester-proofs-test-reseal-door). reseal.trouble_identity is deleted and its three call sites (:361/:412/:484 raises, :437 clear) call seal_trouble_identity; announce_verdict_change (:561) and the green round-trip clear (:790) call it too — the string "validation-verdict-changed-" no longer appears in cairn/devices/tester. reseal.py's docstring paragraph 'ONE TROUBLE PER COMPONENT…' is replaced by one sentence pointing at this decision. ALTERNATE BODY, used if open-69cd989012c4 is answered per COMPONENT: returns "seal-red-" + the repo-relative path of component_root_for(proof_path) slugged by _SLUG (today's reseal body, e.g. seal-red-cairn-devices-tester), and the store's announce and round-trip clear then fold every proof of a component under that one key. Under EITHER answer the function's name, address, signature and all five call sites are the same; the builder picks the body from the recorded answer and nothing else changes.

THE READER AND THE CHECK (D2): def standing_raises(log_home: Path, *, recipient: str) -> set[str] in cairn/devices/tester/reseal.py reads only files named *.raise_trouble.json and *.clear_trouble.json directly under log_home (the raiser's own emission tree, ~/.cairn/logs/tester/0 live; a temp dir in proofs), sorted by filename (the stamp is the filename prefix), and returns the pointers whose LAST event is a raise or whose last clear has values.by != recipient. It imports nothing from cairn/devices/trouble and writes nothing. The ladder's clear at reseal.py:437 becomes: if identity in raised_this_run or identity in standing_raises(raiser.log_home, recipient=CLEARS_FOR): raiser.clear_trouble(...); else no emission. raised_this_run is a module-level set the three raise sites add to. log_home for a ModuleRaiser is the directory emit() writes into (diagnostic.py's home attribute).

THE PROOFS: (a) test_reseal_door.py gains three teeth on its existing fake-raiser + temp-root fixture: 'a green reseal with nothing raised emits no clear' (fake raiser records zero clears), 'ladder red then hand green leaves nothing outstanding for cc' (raise then TesterDevice.run_proof green → exactly one clear, same pointer, by cc; standing_raises afterwards is empty), and 'standing_raises reads raise/clear pairs' (a temp tree with raise k1, clear k1 by cc, raise k2, clear k2 by someone-else → {k2}). (b) test_the_seal_announces_itself.py gains 'the store's announce pointer equals seal_trouble_identity(proof) equals the ladder's raise pointer' — three strings compared on one proof path. (c) the census tooth in test_reseal_door.py reads the LIVE ~/.cairn/logs/tester/0 read-only, restricted to files whose stamp is later than git log -1 --format=%cI of this build's commit (skipped with a printed reason when git is absent, i.e. the hollow worktree), and asserts by invariant: every clear_trouble pointer after the bound has an earlier raise_trouble pointer after the bound, and no pointer has two cc clears without a raise between — never a count. All four proofs (test_diagnostic, test_reseal_door, test_the_seal_announces_itself, test_validation_store) are resealed under netns and name their teeth (77f15efd5a96).

decision.text: STACK AT THE RAISE (Akien, open-f998fae25b35: 'a trouble should have it's diagnostic info too, so the call stack will be in there. if not, we make it so' — measured 0 of 249 raises carry one): DiagnosticBase.raise_trouble in cairn/tools/base/diagnostic.py adds detail["stack"] = traceback.format_stack()[:-1] (a list of strings, innermost last, the raise_trouble frame itself dropped) to EVERY raise before emit(); clear_trouble adds nothing.
